protocolBuilder.geospatial.appearanceDes: Customize the colours, style, and features of the map.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.colorHint: Choose the colour used to outline selectable GeoJSON areas and highlight the area a participant selects. Use a colour that remains easy to distinguish from the chosen Mapbox style.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.layerHint: Choose a GeoJSON resource containing the geographic areas participants can select. Each feature should include a property that identifies the area, such as a census tract, ZIP code, or neighbourhood; after selecting the resource, choose which property value to record below. Avoid very large files or features outside the study area, as they can slow map loading.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.propertyHint: The value of this property is what gets stored when a participant selects an area, so choose one that is filled in and unique for every feature — a census tract, a postcode, or a neighbourhood name.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.propertyNoPro: The features in this layer carry no properties, so there is nothing to record a selection as. Choose a layer whose features are labelled.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.searchHint: Allow participants to search the map for addresses, neighbourhoods, and points of interest.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.styleHint: Choose the Mapbox basemap displayed beneath the selectable GeoJSON areas. Consider the contrast between the basemap, the configured outline colour, and any place labels participants need to read.
protocolBuilder.geospatial.viewDescripti: Set where the map is centred and how far it is zoomed when the stage opens.
protocolBuilder.narrativePedigree.diseas: Select a colour for this disease.
Choose a colour for this disease.
Shown to the participant in the pedigree's key, so it should be a name they recognise.
Define the diseases to visualise on the pedigree. Each disease maps to a boolean node attribute from the source Family Pedigree stage.
protocolBuilder.narrativePedigree.source: Select the Family Pedigree stage whose network data this Narrative Pedigree will visualise. Only Family Pedigree stages are listed here.
The stage this one reads is no longer a Family Pedigree, so there is no family for it to visualise. Choose a Family Pedigree stage instead.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.background: Gives the inner rings more room than the outer ones, so nodes placed near the centre overlap less.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.composerEd: The kind of connection the participant draws. Its name and colour come from the codebook.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.composerNo: Configure attribute mappings, layout behaviour, group hulls, and editable node attributes.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.presetConn: Select the edge types shown in this visualisation preset.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.presetsDes: Create visualisations that researchers can switch between during the interview.
protocolBuilder.networkCanvas.presetsFie: Add one or more "presets" below, to create different visualisations that you can switch between within the interview.
protocolBuilder.pedigree.dependentStages: These stages visualise this pedigree's network and map their own attributes onto its node type: {stageNames}. Changing the node type here will leave them pointing at attributes the new type does not have.
